title: How to Open a Locker at ZX Bank Branch

nodes.title: Step 1: Check Locker Availability
nodes.summary: Visit the nearest ZX Bank branch or call it to check locker sizes and availability; popular sizes are Small, Medium and Large, and availability may vary by location.

nodes.title: Step 2: Eligibility Criteria
nodes.summary: Applicant must be an existing ZX Bank customer with a savings or current account (or open one), and KYC must be updated with valid photo ID (Aadhaar/Passport/Driving License), address proof, and a recent passport-sized photo.

nodes.title: Step 3: Locker Application Process
nodes.summary: Visit the branch with original documents and photocopies, fill the 'Locker Facility Application Form', attach KYC documents, then read and sign the Locker Hirer Agreement provided by the bank.

nodes.title: Step 4: Security Deposit & Rent Payment
nodes.summary: Pay a refundable security deposit; locker rent varies by size and city and is typically paid annually, by cash, cheque, or direct bank transfer.

nodes.title: Step 5: Locker Allotment & Access
nodes.summary: Upon approval a locker number is allotted; customer receives locker keys (usually two; the bank does not keep duplicates), and a bank officer explains the locker location and operating procedure.

nodes.title: Step 6: Operating the Locker
nodes.summary: The locker is operated during branch working hours by visiting with locker keys and valid ID, signing the Locker Access Register each time; all operations are conducted privately in the vault area.

nodes.title: Additional Guidelines
nodes.summary: Recommendations: nominate a beneficiary; opt for a joint locker with another account holder; inform the bank immediately on losing a key (charges apply for key duplication/drilling); pay annual rent on time to avoid late fees or a locker freeze.

nodes.title: For Assistance
nodes.summary: Assistance via the nearest ZX Bank branch, website www.zxbank.asia, or customer care contacts listed on the official website or mobile app.
